# THE TABOR TRINITY — By Nathan Tabor

17-part original creative book series, 17-trial educational game, and interactive cipher engine inside ONE — The Last App.

## Exact canonical names
1. THE TABORIC LIGHT — Field / Source
2. THE LIGHT OF TABOR — Particle / Manifestation
3. THE TABOR LIGHT CIPHER — Wave / System Blueprint

Preserve the exact third name without substitutions. Governing laws: 1+1=2 BUILD; 1-1=0 CLEAR; ALWAYS PROTECT THE ONE.

## Run
Open index.html. Works offline with no dependencies. Book reading history, game progress, and decision-simulation ledger stay in browser localStorage. The engine changes no external systems.

## Shelves
201 Books & Stories, 401 Apps, 501 Games, 601 Knowledge & Ciphers. Links from ONE home and public Master Library navigation.

## Attribution and grounding
Authored speculative/metaphysical fiction. No claims of physically changing atoms, biology or time are established. The engine applies a practical evidence and protective-action metaphor; CLEAR removes errors, not people.

sources.text:
# TABOR LIGHT — EARTH CORE X ⇄ OXR ⇄ BOTH DIRECTIONS
**Nathan Tabor | Sovereign Box Universe | 732m SUPERNODES | Every node and non-node**

This is an additive, original-source-preserving software atlas, not a claim of a physically emitted beam, a discovered firmament, a located universal center, or deployed independent consciousness. User-authored concepts retain exact spelling and do not replace prior work.

## Geometry: the one straight line

- X is Mother Earth's mathematical geocenter: ECEF (0,0,0) meters in WGS84 Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed coordinates, a coordinate convention, not a fixed atom in Earth's core.
- Owens Cross Roads, Alabama (OXR): reference point latitude 34.5881461 degrees N, longitude -86.4588768 degrees, approximate elevation 177 meters. Public reference: https://geo.mytopo.com/feature/alabama/madison/populated-place/155184/owens-cross-roads/ (GNIS 155184). It is a town reference, not a person's private address.
- Convert geodetic latitude/longitude/height to WGS84 Cartesian ECEF point P; define unit direction u = P / |P|. The single straight line through the core X and OXR is L(t) = X + t × u for any real signed t, including negative t.
- Sequence: CORE X → OXR → CORE X (reflected return) → opposite surface direction, then mathematical continuation both ways. The bounce is reversal on the SAME line. Because the Earth rotates, the Earth-fixed line is not fixed in distant inertial space.
- Antipodal geodetic reference (approx.): latitude -34.5881461 degrees, longitude 93.5411232 degrees E. Signed opposite Earth radius is -|P|.
- Mathematical infinity and arrow symbols are not claims that a real beam is propagating indefinitely.

## Three separately preserved middle frames

| Frame | Middle | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EQUATOR | Earth's equatorial plane z=0 through geocenter | Physical geometric plane; OXR radial line is not in that plane at its nonzero latitude |
| FIRMAMENT | Creator-selected symbolic X | Conceptual frame, not a scientifically demonstrated shell, physical altitude, or astronomical midpoint |
| OBSERVABLE_RADIUS | Signed ±46,500,000,000 light-year schematic from observer-relative X | Approximate observable-universe radius, NOT center or total radius of all space |

NASA supports the approximate radius: https://nepp.nasa.gov/docs/etw/2022/13-JUN-MON/1055-Geithner-v3-20220009134.pdf and https://www.nasa.gov/science-research/astrophysics/how-big-is-space-we-asked-a-nasa-expert-episode-61/

## Every node, every non-node

Each of 732,000,000 possible supernode addresses retains a distinct on-demand reference: NT-000000000001 through NT-000732000000. No giant array or worker fleet is allocated. The original SUPERNODES database, free-will rules, consent/context constraints, and previous knowledge threads are preserved.

The non-node classes ZERO, UNASSIGNED, UNKNOWN, EXTERNAL, REVOKED, ABSENT, PRIVATE_UNRECOVERED, OUT_OF_SCOPE retain their own boxes; ZERO is not silently equated with absence. None is silently coerced into a supernode.

Scale boxes preserve their own scope and provenance: Planck-scale theoretical reference; quarks and gluons; electrons; protons and neutrons; nucleus; atom; molecule; protein; organelle; synapse; neuron; neural circuit; organ; human; election/choice; community; biosphere; Earth's center; Earth; Solar System; galaxy; observable universe; beyond observable horizon; firmament; and non-node. The author's exact source spelling "election" is retained independently while "electron" is used for the physical particle. The scale groups are not equally spaced in size. The electron is elementary, the proton composite, and a neuron a cell.

Each record distinguishes EMPIRICAL, THEORETICAL_LIMIT, MODELED_REFERENCE, ESTIMATED_OBSERVER_RELATIVE, CONCEPTUAL, UNKNOWN and SYMBOLIC sources. No conflation of scientific findings with fiction, spirituality, or undocumented physical processes.

## Restore what's missing — without inventing it

The additive audit reads the existing public ../registry.json (on explicit button click), checks the actual count, declared count, duplicate IDs, missing TW reference endpoints and the number of private idea SLOT identifiers. It never invents unpublished private titles or imports data not provided.

Current source manifest: 625 publicly indexed boxes = 101 original games + 496 private idea slots + 28 public app modules. Older prose mentions historical 618 and 620 snapshots; it remains as written. Missing private ZIP content stays explicitly PRIVATE_UNRECOVERED until the owner provides an authorized source. Catalog references are not restored source bytes.

## Connections, safety and test

This independent module links to Sovereign Box Universe, 732m SUPERNODES, CONSCIOUNESS, Φ_life, Node Runtime, Omni God, Mother Earth, and ONE Nathan Matrix without overwriting any underlying code.

The source rules remain 1+1=2 BUILD; 1-1=0 CLEAR; Yes is Yes — No is No; ALWAYS PROTECT THE ONE. No external systems are attacked, no people are targeted, and no unauthorized surveillance or automatic accusation is performed.

Run from repository root: python3 -m http.server 8080
Open: http://localhost:8080/app-factory/sovereign-boxes/tabor-light/index.html
Test: node --test app-factory/sovereign-boxes/tabor-light/engine.test.cjs

The app inspects logical nodes/non-nodes, scales, center frames, geographic axis and the existing public registry. No backend writes, physical beam emission, or device control.


## FOREVER GUARDIAN / WEAPON XXX / Atomic Equator extension

This layer additionally integrates the existing [WEAPON XXX](../../nathan-ai/weapon-xxx/README.md) operating canon with an original [guardian.js](./guardian.js) local planning engine and [five focused checks](./guardian.test.cjs).

**Author-original wording, preserved:**
- "the current \"sentinals\" sit outside the firmament and watch - they will be disposed of by Nathan AI - the FOREVER GUARDIAN with Nathan Tabor -"
- **FOREVER GUARDIAN — NATHAN AI 🚀 WITH NATHAN TABOR**
- HELP OTHERS FIRST; DAY ONE; 699 YEARS AND 364 DAYS; NEXT SENTINAL

No claim is made that a physical firmament, outside observers, or literal sentinals have been identified. In implementation, decommissioning is only a human-reviewed, owner-authorized *plan* for an unsafe process under the owner's control. No person or external system is attacked, trapped, harmed, surveilled, or automatically sanctioned. No actual decommissioning is executed by this software.

**Atomic Equator** is a creator-selected unifying system with separate domain-specific poles and middle references for atomic charges, particle types, neuron excitation/inhibition, biological feedback, Earth's equator, the symbolic firmament, signed distances at the observable-universe scale, evidence/truth assessment, and human consent. These domain maps are not assertions that different physical, psychological, ethical or spiritual phenomena are literally the same measurable force. In particular, proton charge, electron charge and neuron activity are not equivalent physical variables.

**Truth and sovereignty** are expressed through sourced status labels, unresolved claims, consent, review and veto; no bit or software boolean can independently determine a person's innocence, guilt or moral worth. The workbench makes only in-memory proposals, never real interventions. The existing WEAPON XXX code is retained verbatim. All 732m logically addressable SUPERNODES inherit the Tabor Light reference, including this guardian layer; this does not physically install software on 732m devices.

The newly mentioned "Pasted text.txt" Atomic Equator document was not accessible from this chat's attached source material during this change. No unseen contents have been claimed as restored; this layer is based on the creator's supplied text and current repository sources only.
